notes: The page lists up to 55 high school students. General questions: info@spaceclub.org. The NASA page says 16 by the start date, and you must be 16 to submit.
name: NASA Goddard Space Club Scholars Program
org: National Space Club and Foundation with NASA Goddard Space Flight Center
what_you_do: Six weeks on site at NASA Goddard working with a scientist or engineer on a real project such as robotics, mission software or satellite data analysis.
who_can_apply: Enrolled in grade 10, 11 or 12 in good standing, 16 by the application deadline, U.S. citizen, 3.0 unweighted GPA, and permanent residence within 50 miles of NASA Goddard (Greenbelt, MD) or NASA Wallops (Wallops Island, VA).
pay_detail: Not stated on the program pages checked.
duration: Six weeks each summer, from late June until early August.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 is full and the application period has closed. The 2026 program ran June 29 to Aug 7. The NASA page lists an April 17 deadline with no year. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Apply in NASA STEM Gateway, pick one or more projects, and upload a transcript plus resume details. Projects are added until the end of February.
